sandbachFocus: Sandbach United travel to Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday, looking to bounce back after consecutive defeats dropped them to second place. Despite their recent slump, Sandbach remain just one point behind AFC Bridgnorth and will be eager to return to winning ways against one of the division's struggling sides. Cheadle Heath sit 18th with just five points from eight matches, making this a winnable fixture for the visitors to press their title credentials.
divisionWide: AFC Bridgnorth's commanding position at the summit faces no immediate threat this weekend as the chasing pack battle amongst themselves. Stafford Town host fifth-placed Alsager Town in what should be a competitive mid-table clash, with Stafford's inconsistent form (WLWDLW) pitting them against an Alsager side struggling near the foot of the table. New Mills entertain Market Drayton Town in a fixture between two mid-table contenders; New Mills' superior goal difference and points tally make them clear favourites against a Town side on an indifferent run. At the bottom, Bilston Town welcome Widnes Town in a crucial basement battle, with both sides seeking rare victories—Widnes have managed just two points all season. Wednesfield Community host Allscott Heath in another lower-table encounter where neither side can afford further slippage. Meanwhile, Dawley Town's poor recent form (LWWLLL) is tested at home by Brereton Social, who themselves are searching for consistency after mixed recent results.
